items.html: And this is called the secret of wisdom — the internality of the lower wisdom; and by this they illuminate and sparkle with the radiance of the upper wisdom, for the soul of the lower wisdom is the radiance and brilliance of the upper wisdom, in the secret of the bride of Moshe; and she is the rib, the point of the Yod, in the secret of a Yod at the head and a Yod at the end: the Yud of the name of four, the Yud of the name Adonai, as is known.
